description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the Popularity of different models across three domains under varying accuracy and answer conditions. The horizontal category axis displays three domains in the following order: "Movies", "Songs", and "Basketball". The vertical value axis is labeled "Popularity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 220, with tick marks at regular intervals of 40 units. For each domain on the horizontal axis, there is a cluster of nine bars. These bars are grouped by color to represent three models: blue for "Llama3", red for "Qwen2", and gold for "ChatGPT". Within each color group, three distinct patterns represent different conditions: a cross-hatched pattern for "Acc=0 & GT Ans", diagonal stripes for "Acc=0 & Gene Ans", and a solid fill for "Acc=1 & GT Ans". The bars vary significantly in height across the categories, with the "Movies" category containing the shortest bars overall and the "Basketball" category containing the tallest. The shortest bar is the cross-hatched gold bar in the "Movies" category, with an approximate value of 27. The tallest bar is the solid red bar in the "Basketball" category, reaching approximately 212. In the "Basketball" category, the values are notably higher, with the solid blue bar at roughly 178, the diagonal red bar at 189, and the diagonal gold bar at 172. In the "Songs" category, values range from approximately 47 for the cross-hatched gold bar to 86 for the solid red bar. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically, and the bars are visually distinguished by both color and pattern to separate the models and conditions without any specific sorting by height.
